grounding.states: A dark, quiet room can help babies sleep
grounding.from: A dark, quiet room can help babies sleep.

grounding.states: Put babies to bed drowsy but awake
grounding.from: put babies to bed drowsy but awake, since they sleep best when drowsy

grounding.states: Naps at the same time each day and for about the same length
grounding.from: Babies get the most out of naps if they take them at the same time each day and for about the same length of time.

grounding.states: A consistent daily routine with a story read in a calming voice helps
grounding.from: A consistent daily routine helps. ... a story read in a calming voice.

grounding.states: Nap in his own bed or crib (toddler)
grounding.from: a toddler at home should nap in his own bed or crib

grounding.states: Babies sleep on their backs with no blankets or soft items in the crib
grounding.from: Put babies to sleep on their backs, with no blankets, stuffed toys or other soft items in the crib or bassinet.

value.answer: Depends a bit on his age. For a baby or toddler: nap at the same time and about the same length each day, keep the room dark and quiet, put him down drowsy but still awake, and do a calm routine first, like a story or a lullaby. Make sure he naps in his own bed, and for a baby, on his back with nothing soft in the crib. How old is he?
